entries.rationale: BEH-5 and its acceptance criteria fully specify the --auto skip-and-note behavior; the plan supplies exact prose and tests. No golden sample, but the codebase's own format-note usage is strong precedent. Two files (SKILL.md + shared test suite).
BEH-1/2/4 fully specified; task mirrors skills/validate/SKILL.md:588-595 and skills/build/SKILL.md:868-872 nearly verbatim. Mechanical, one file plus shared test suite.

BEH-3/BEH-7 and the Error Cases table are well specified, but the bounded intra-invocation counter has no direct precedent in the codebase (only the sibling attempt_cap doc-comment convention to mirror for the manifest key), touches two source modules (skills/, templates/) plus the shared test suite, and combines counter-tracking, early-exit, and config-default patterns in a new composition.

BEH-8 plus the plan's detailed RI-1 resolution notes pin the exact call site. No curated golden sample for merging three note sources into one update() call across two branches, but it is a bounded extension of an existing single-file write path.

BEH-9 plus the plan's RI-2/RI-3 resolution notes are explicit. Extends an existing bash env-var-with-fallback pattern already present in the same file (${USER}/local). Two files (SKILL.md + a docs file), mechanical resolve-once-reuse change.
BEH-6 is fully specified and the task only appends a token name to an existing enumerated carve-out bullet (ADEV-BUILD/ADEV-VALIDATE precedent already in file). Single file, purely mechanical.

Non-code coordination task (file a board note); precondition bullet 3 names the requirement though the delivery mechanism ('or an equivalent message') is slightly open-ended. No files touched, mechanical board-note action using the established /adev:issues workflow.
